# Compass Blue at Lahaina Shores

> Compass Blue at Lahaina Shores is one privately owned, owner-hosted studio vacation rental inside Lahaina Shores Beach Resort, an oceanfront building at 475 Front Street, Lahaina, Maui, Hawaii 96761, in the Kaanapali area of West Maui. It is not affiliated with the Compass real estate brokerage.

## Key facts

- Exact name: Compass Blue at Lahaina Shores
- Type: studio vacation rental, 1 bathroom, sleeps 3 (queen bed plus two armchairs that convert to twin beds)
- Address: Lahaina Shores Beach Resort, 475 Front Street, Lahaina, HI 96761
- Coordinates: 20.8672, -156.6751
- Building: oceanfront, with the beach, pool and hot tub steps from the lobby
- View from the studio: the lanai faces the West Maui Mountains. It is not an ocean-view unit and is not advertised as one.
- Kitchen: full kitchen with dishwasher
- Bathroom: private, with solid doors separating the toilet and shower from the vanity
- Air conditioning and WiFi: yes
- Parking: resort lot $15 per day, or free street parking on Shaw Street
- Check-in 3:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM. No pets.
- Host: Kristie, the owner, hosting for more than 20 years (13 on Airbnb). Airbnb Superhost; the listing is an Airbnb Guest Favorite.
- Not part of Castle Resorts' rental pool. Castle Resorts runs the building's front desk.

## Nearby

- Pau Bakery: in the building lobby
- Surf lessons: on the beach next door (two surf schools, including Bully's)
- Lahaina Harbor and the Lahaina Banyan Tree: 2 to 3 blocks. Boat tours here are walkable; other West Maui tours leave from Mala Wharf, Māʻalaea Harbor or Kaanapali Beach, so check the departure point when booking.
- Old Lahaina Luau, Honu Oceanside, Star Noodle, Aloha Mixed Plate, Coco Deck: along the oceanfront walk
- ʻUlu o Lele Marketplace (Waineʻe and Papalaua Streets; Front Street Fresh food truck): about a mile
- Foodland Farms and Safeway: 1.8 miles
- Whalers Village and the Kaanapali resorts: about 5 miles north
- Kahului Airport (OGG): 45 to 55 minutes by car

## Wildlife seen from the beach in front of the building

Humpback whales (November through May, most active January through March), Hawaiian monk seals and green sea turtles. Sightings are never guaranteed. Whales are watched from the beach, not from the studio.

## Lahaina after the August 2023 fire

Lahaina Shores survived the fire and is open, along with the beach, harbor activities and nearby restaurants. Historic Front Street north of the harbor is still rebuilding.
